jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer – HPE Campus and Branch
jobs.description:
This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Description

Job Description:

Senior Systems Engineer – HPE Campus and Branch

***This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home, however candidates must reside in ME, NH, MA, RI, CT, DE, NJ, DC, VA, WV, PA, MD, NY, and VT.***

Job Description:

This is a customer-facing sales role that covers multiple states and may require approximately 50% of your time traveling.

HPE Campus & Branch Specialist

If you are looking for your next challenge and want to make a meaningful impact helping customers modernize their campus and branch networks, this is an opportunity to join a high-performing specialist team focused on HPE Mist. HPE Mist delivers AI-native networking experiences across wireless, wired, WAN, network access, location services, and cloud-based operations.

Role Summary

As a Senior Systems Engineer - HPE Campus & Branch, you will serve as an HPE Mist specialist partnering with the AI for Networking Seller and be the trusted technical advisor supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers throughout the customer lifecycle. You will partner closely with HPE account teams to win new customers, expand strategic accounts, and ensure existing customers remain successful.

You will lead from the front by driving technical discovery, architecture discussions, demonstrations, workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements. You will help HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers develop winning technical strategies, differentiate HPE Mist from competitive solutions, and guide customers from initial evaluation through successful adoption and operational outcomes.

Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, executive presence, and the ability to build trusted relationships across customers, partners, sales teams, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Partner with HPE Sales Teams

Act as the HPE Mist technical specialist supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers across strategic sales opportunities.
Partner with account teams to develop technical account strategies that drive new-logo acquisition, competitive displacement and customer expansion.
Engage early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify technical and business requirements, and align HPE Mist solutions to desired outcomes.
Provide technical leadership throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from qualification and discovery through design, validation, close, deployment, and adoption.
Build strong working relationships with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers and operate as an extension of the account team.

Lead Technical Sales Engagements

Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, technical presentations, solution demonstrations, and executive briefings.
Translate complex customer requirements into clear, differentiated HPE Mist architectures and solution recommendations.
Communicate effectively with audiences ranging from network engineers and architects to IT leaders, CISOs, and CIOs.
Develop competitive technical strategies and position the unique value of HPE Mist AI-native networking against alternative solutions.
Create compelling customer experiences that build technical confidence, accelerate decisions, and improve win rates.

Drive Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept

Own and lead HPE Mist demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements from planning through successful completion.
Define clear POC objectives, success criteria, test plans, customer responsibilities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
Configure, deploy, validate, and troubleshoot HPE Mist solutions in customer environments.
Partner with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers to convert successful technical evaluations into production opportunities.
Document results, lessons learned, and reusable best practices that improve future demonstrations and POCs.

Ensure Customer Success

Serve as a trusted technical advisor before, during, and after the sale to help customers realize the full value of HPE Mist.
Provide architecture guidance, migration planning, deployment best practices, operational recommendations, and adoption support.
Proactively identify technical risks, adoption barriers, and customer health concerns, then coordinate the right HPE resources to drive resolution.
Partner with Customer Success, Support, Product Management, and Engineering on strategic customer needs and escalations.
Help maintain happy customers who become long-term advocates and references for HPE Mist.

Maintain HPE Mist Technical Excellence

Develop and maintain deep expertise across HPE Mist wireless, wired, WAN, access assurance, location services, cloud operations, automation, and AI-driven capabilities.
Stay current on product releases, architectures, competitive developments, industry standards, and emerging campus and branch technologies.
Be hands-on with design, configuration, demonstrations, troubleshooting, and customer validation.
Create and share technical content, design guidance, demos, best practices, and reusable enablement materials.
Contribute actively to the broader HPE Mist technical community and promote a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

Enable HPE Teams and Partners

Enable HPE Territory Managers, Systems Engineers, partners, and distributors through mentoring, technical training, workshops, and opportunity support.
Help scale HPE Mist expertise across the field by sharing repeatable sales motions, competitive insights, demo practices, POC methodologies, and lessons learned.
Support customer events, webinars, seminars, executive briefings, partner sessions, and field enablement programs.
Collaborate across HPE teams to ensure consistent positioning and a unified customer experience.

HPE Campus & Branch Mist Expertise

The successful candidate will develop and maintain specialist-level expertise across:

HPE Mist AI and Marvis AI
Enterprise wireless networking and Wi-Fi 6E/Wi-Fi 7
Campus and branch switching
Wireless Assurance and Wired Assurance
WAN Assurance and branch networking
NAC, identity, and network access control
Location Services and user engagement capabilities
Cloud management, APIs, automation, and AI-driven operations
Campus routing, segmentation, resiliency, and security architectures

Qualifications

Candidate must reside in one of the following states: ME, NH, MA, RI, CT, DE, NJ, DC, VA, WV, PA, MD, NY, and VT.
7+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, technical consulting, or a related enterprise networking role.
Proven success supporting complex technical sales cycles, customer demonstrations, architecture workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements.
Deep knowledge of enterprise wireless networking, including RF fundamentals, industry standards, site surveys, high-density design, roaming, security, and troubleshooting.
Strong campus and branch networking knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs, TCP/IP, Layer 2/Layer 3 design, routing, switching, multicast, QoS, ACLs, firewalls, segmentation, and resiliency.
Experience with identity and access technologies including 802.1X, AAA, RADIUS, EAP methods, certificates, SAML, and common client operating systems.
Experience designing and supporting large campus, distributed enterprise, and branch networking environments.
Hands-on experience with wireless design and validation tools such as Ekahau, Hamina, NetAlly, or iBwave.
Familiarity with REST APIs, Python, scripting, automation, cloud integrations, or Infrastructure as Code is highly desirable.
Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
Executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with technical practitioners, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic opportunities and customer engagements simultaneously.
Self-motivated, collaborative, and passionate about customer success, technical excellence, and winning as a team.
Ability to travel up to 50% based on customer and business needs.

Preferred Experience And Certifications

Prior experience with HPE Mist, Aruba or another leading enterprise networking platform.
Experience supporting competitive displacement and complex enterprise transformation initiatives.
Relevant industry certifications such as CWNP/CWNE, JNCIP/JNCIE, CCNP/CCIE, CISSP, or equivalent.

What Success Looks Like

You are recognized as the HPE Mist expert that Territory Managers, Systems Engineers, partners, and customers trust for their most important campus and branch opportunities. You help HPE win new customers, expand strategic accounts, execute successful demonstrations and POCs, and ensure customers achieve lasting technical and business outcomes. You lead from the front, raise the technical capability of the broader team, and help establish HPE Mist as the best technical solution for modern campus and branch networking.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

#networking, #sales

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

jobs.title: Sr Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
The Kansas City National Security Campus (KCNSC), managed and operated by Honeywell Federal Manufacturing & Technologies, is a premier advanced manufacturing facility that supports the safety, security, reliability and effectiveness of our nation's nuclear deterrent. With nearly 7,000 employees combined in Kansas City, Missouri, and Albuquerque, New Mexico, KCNSC protects our nation and allies by producing trusted national security products and services for the U.S. Department of Energy's National Nuclear Security Administration.

We create innovative solutions to complex national security challenges, and lead with accountability, collaboration and an unwavering dedication to our mission and core values.

Are you ready to do work that matters?

Summary

The Sr Electrical Engineer role involves providing engineering support of highly technical and advanced manufacturing processes, with specialized qualifications, knowledge and skill. This position also requires performing project management while designing, developing, evaluating, and quality control functions of highly complex engineering projects. Sr Electrical Engineers complete projects while offering innovative solutions and applying mathematical, physical science, and advanced engineering technologies.

Duties and Responsibilities

Acts as authority within area of expertise with wide versatility of experience and capability.
May perform project planning and manage project resources, including multiple individuals and disciplines, to achieve quality, delivery, and cost objectives.
Monitors and analyzes electrical testing of products and troubleshoots test failures. Coordinates with stakeholders to adjust test limits and develop rework processes on defective products.
Writes technical reports on results and conclusions drawn from experiments conducted and incorporates findings in formal specifications.
Transitions design agency concepts into production by coordinating the activities of engineering, quality, manufacturing, and related organizations.
Leads developing operating procedures, work instructions, and inspection criteria on new products and components.
Defines/recommends design changes, designs of experiments, and equipment necessary to assure product quality.
Plans and performs engineering testing and uses advanced statistical and scientific methods to address and resolve critical engineering and production problems. Originates, refines, and releases complex manufacturing or inspection work directions.
Determines acceptability of processes and materials in conjunction with customers, design agency and other affected organizations.
Provides technical consultation to management and leads technical project teams.
Evaluates and implements innovations and technological advances that improve quality, reduce flowtime, improve productivity, and enhance operational surety.
Leads, trains and mentors Engineer I, II and III on various test processes and procedures.

You Must Have

Ability to travel up to 15% of the time
Ability to work remote, hybrid, or on-site as directed by management and is determined by the needs of the business.

Job Description:

Senior Systems Engineer – HPE Campus and Branch

***This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home, however candidates must reside in ME, NH, MA, RI, CT, DE, NJ, DC, VA, WV, PA, MD, NY, and VT.***

Job Description:

This is a customer-facing sales role that covers multiple states and may require approximately 50% of your time traveling.

HPE Campus & Branch Specialist

If you are looking for your next challenge and want to make a meaningful impact helping customers modernize their campus and branch networks, this is an opportunity to join a high-performing specialist team focused on HPE Mist. HPE Mist delivers AI-native networking experiences across wireless, wired, WAN, network access, location services, and cloud-based operations.

Role Summary

As a Senior Systems Engineer - HPE Campus & Branch, you will serve as an HPE Mist specialist partnering with the AI for Networking Seller and be the trusted technical advisor supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers throughout the customer lifecycle. You will partner closely with HPE account teams to win new customers, expand strategic accounts, and ensure existing customers remain successful.

You will lead from the front by driving technical discovery, architecture discussions, demonstrations, workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements. You will help HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers develop winning technical strategies, differentiate HPE Mist from competitive solutions, and guide customers from initial evaluation through successful adoption and operational outcomes.

Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, executive presence, and the ability to build trusted relationships across customers, partners, sales teams, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Partner with HPE Sales Teams

Act as the HPE Mist technical specialist supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers across strategic sales opportunities.
Partner with account teams to develop technical account strategies that drive new-logo acquisition, competitive displacement and customer expansion.
Engage early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify technical and business requirements, and align HPE Mist solutions to desired outcomes.
Provide technical leadership throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from qualification and discovery through design, validation, close, deployment, and adoption.
Build strong working relationships with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers and operate as an extension of the account team.

Lead Technical Sales Engagements

Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, technical presentations, solution demonstrations, and executive briefings.
Translate complex customer requirements into clear, differentiated HPE Mist architectures and solution recommendations.
Communicate effectively with audiences ranging from network engineers and architects to IT leaders, CISOs, and CIOs.
Develop competitive technical strategies and position the unique value of HPE Mist AI-native networking against alternative solutions.
Create compelling customer experiences that build technical confidence, accelerate decisions, and improve win rates.

Drive Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept

Own and lead HPE Mist demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements from planning through successful completion.
Define clear POC objectives, success criteria, test plans, customer responsibilities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
Configure, deploy, validate, and troubleshoot HPE Mist solutions in customer environments.
Partner with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers to convert successful technical evaluations into production opportunities.
Document results, lessons learned, and reusable best practices that improve future demonstrations and POCs.

Ensure Customer Success

Serve as a trusted technical advisor before, during, and after the sale to help customers realize the full value of HPE Mist.
Provide architecture guidance, migration planning, deployment best practices, operational recommendations, and adoption support.
Proactively identify technical risks, adoption barriers, and customer health concerns, then coordinate the right HPE resources to drive resolution.
Partner with Customer Success, Support, Product Management, and Engineering on strategic customer needs and escalations.
Help maintain happy customers who become long-term advocates and references for HPE Mist.

Maintain HPE Mist Technical Excellence

Develop and maintain deep expertise across HPE Mist wireless, wired, WAN, access assurance, location services, cloud operations, automation, and AI-driven capabilities.
Stay current on product releases, architectures, competitive developments, industry standards, and emerging campus and branch technologies.
Be hands-on with design, configuration, demonstrations, troubleshooting, and customer validation.
Create and share technical content, design guidance, demos, best practices, and reusable enablement materials.
Contribute actively to the broader HPE Mist technical community and promote a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

Enable HPE Teams and Partners

Enable HPE Territory Managers, Systems Engineers, partners, and distributors through mentoring, technical training, workshops, and opportunity support.
Help scale HPE Mist expertise across the field by sharing repeatable sales motions, competitive insights, demo practices, POC methodologies, and lessons learned.
Support customer events, webinars, seminars, executive briefings, partner sessions, and field enablement programs.
Collaborate across HPE teams to ensure consistent positioning and a unified customer experience.

HPE Campus & Branch Mist Expertise

The successful candidate will develop and maintain specialist-level expertise across:

HPE Mist AI and Marvis AI
Enterprise wireless networking and Wi-Fi 6E/Wi-Fi 7
Campus and branch switching
Wireless Assurance and Wired Assurance
WAN Assurance and branch networking
NAC, identity, and network access control
Location Services and user engagement capabilities
Cloud management, APIs, automation, and AI-driven operations
Campus routing, segmentation, resiliency, and security architectures

Qualifications

Candidate must reside in one of the following states: ME, NH, MA, RI, CT, DE, NJ, DC, VA, WV, PA, MD, NY, and VT.
7+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, technical consulting, or a related enterprise networking role.
Proven success supporting complex technical sales cycles, customer demonstrations, architecture workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements.
Deep knowledge of enterprise wireless networking, including RF fundamentals, industry standards, site surveys, high-density design, roaming, security, and troubleshooting.
Strong campus and branch networking knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs, TCP/IP, Layer 2/Layer 3 design, routing, switching, multicast, QoS, ACLs, firewalls, segmentation, and resiliency.
Experience with identity and access technologies including 802.1X, AAA, RADIUS, EAP methods, certificates, SAML, and common client operating systems.
Experience designing and supporting large campus, distributed enterprise, and branch networking environments.
Hands-on experience with wireless design and validation tools such as Ekahau, Hamina, NetAlly, or iBwave.
Familiarity with REST APIs, Python, scripting, automation, cloud integrations, or Infrastructure as Code is highly desirable.
Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
Executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with technical practitioners, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic opportunities and customer engagements simultaneously.
Self-motivated, collaborative, and passionate about customer success, technical excellence, and winning as a team.
Ability to travel up to 50% based on customer and business needs.

Preferred Experience And Certifications

Prior experience with HPE Mist, Aruba or another leading enterprise networking platform.
Experience supporting competitive displacement and complex enterprise transformation initiatives.
Relevant industry certifications such as CWNP/CWNE, JNCIP/JNCIE, CCNP/CCIE, CISSP, or equivalent.

What Success Looks Like

You are recognized as the HPE Mist expert that Territory Managers, Systems Engineers, partners, and customers trust for their most important campus and branch opportunities. You help HPE win new customers, expand strategic accounts, execute successful demonstrations and POCs, and ensure customers achieve lasting technical and business outcomes. You lead from the front, raise the technical capability of the broader team, and help establish HPE Mist as the best technical solution for modern campus and branch networking.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

new_jobs.title: Sr Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
The Kansas City National Security Campus (KCNSC), managed and operated by Honeywell Federal Manufacturing & Technologies, is a premier advanced manufacturing facility that supports the safety, security, reliability and effectiveness of our nation's nuclear deterrent. With nearly 7,000 employees combined in Kansas City, Missouri, and Albuquerque, New Mexico, KCNSC protects our nation and allies by producing trusted national security products and services for the U.S. Department of Energy's National Nuclear Security Administration.

We create innovative solutions to complex national security challenges, and lead with accountability, collaboration and an unwavering dedication to our mission and core values.

Are you ready to do work that matters?

Summary

The Sr Electrical Engineer role involves providing engineering support of highly technical and advanced manufacturing processes, with specialized qualifications, knowledge and skill. This position also requires performing project management while designing, developing, evaluating, and quality control functions of highly complex engineering projects. Sr Electrical Engineers complete projects while offering innovative solutions and applying mathematical, physical science, and advanced engineering technologies.

Duties and Responsibilities

Acts as authority within area of expertise with wide versatility of experience and capability.
May perform project planning and manage project resources, including multiple individuals and disciplines, to achieve quality, delivery, and cost objectives.
Monitors and analyzes electrical testing of products and troubleshoots test failures. Coordinates with stakeholders to adjust test limits and develop rework processes on defective products.
Writes technical reports on results and conclusions drawn from experiments conducted and incorporates findings in formal specifications.
Transitions design agency concepts into production by coordinating the activities of engineering, quality, manufacturing, and related organizations.
Leads developing operating procedures, work instructions, and inspection criteria on new products and components.
Defines/recommends design changes, designs of experiments, and equipment necessary to assure product quality.
Plans and performs engineering testing and uses advanced statistical and scientific methods to address and resolve critical engineering and production problems. Originates, refines, and releases complex manufacturing or inspection work directions.
Determines acceptability of processes and materials in conjunction with customers, design agency and other affected organizations.
Provides technical consultation to management and leads technical project teams.
Evaluates and implements innovations and technological advances that improve quality, reduce flowtime, improve productivity, and enhance operational surety.
Leads, trains and mentors Engineer I, II and III on various test processes and procedures.

You Must Have

Ability to travel up to 15% of the time
Ability to work remote, hybrid, or on-site as directed by management and is determined by the needs of the business.
Bachelor of Science degree from an ABET accredited program in Engineering or Physics
6+ years of relevant experience in engineering or related technical activities
United States Citizenship
Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of this job
Ability to obtain and maintain, if required for position, a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) security clearance (some positions require additional DOE designations)

We Value

Demonstrates knowledge of manufacturing or quality processes and techniques.
Demonstrates working without supervision, with latitude for independent action and decision making.
Demonstrates providing technical guidance, project management guidance, consultative services, and innovative solutions.
Demonstrates experience in project leadership.
